  cardMarketContent = '## Guardians Vol. 3: The Emotional Farewell

Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023) was the emotional finale to James Gunn''s Guardians trilogy. Rocket Raccoon''s origin story was the heart of the film, and the introduction of Adam Warlock added a major Marvel character.

### Key Sets

The **2023 Upper Deck Guardians Vol. 3** set features the full Guardians cast for the final time, plus Will Poulter''s Adam Warlock debut and Chukwudi Iwuji''s High Evolutionary.

### Market Trends

As the final Guardians film, these cards carry ''last appearance'' premium for several characters. Dave Bautista (Drax) has confirmed he is done with the role. Bradley Cooper (Rocket) voice cards are rare. Will Poulter (Adam Warlock) debut cards have long-term potential.',
  keyCards = '- **Chris Pratt as Star-Lord Auto** — Guardians leader ($2,500+)
- **Dave Bautista as Drax Final Auto** — Last MCU appearance ($2,000+)
- **Bradley Cooper as Rocket Auto** — Rare voice actor auto ($3,000+)
- **Will Poulter as Adam Warlock Debut Auto** — Major character debut ($1,500+)
- **Zoe Saldana as Gamora Auto** — Variant Gamora ($2,000+)
- **Karen Gillan as Nebula Auto** — Fan favorite ($1,200+)
- **High Evolutionary Villain Card** — Chilling villain ($800+)',
  content = '## Once More With Feeling

Guardians Vol. 3 is James Gunn''s masterpiece — an emotionally devastating farewell to the team that proved Marvel could make cosmic weirdos into beloved characters. Rocket Raccoon''s origin story is heartbreaking, the High Evolutionary is a genuinely hateable villain, and the ending provides perfect closure for every Guardian. It''s one of the best MCU films ever made.

## The Legacy

- **Rocket''s Origin** — The film revealed Rocket''s tragic backstory as a lab experiment, providing the emotional core
- **James Gunn''s Farewell** — The director''s final MCU film before leaving to lead DC Studios
- **Adam Warlock** — Will Poulter debuted as the cosmic powerhouse, a character fans waited years for
- **Team Disbanded** — Each Guardian got a satisfying ending: Quill returned to Earth, Rocket leads the new Guardians, Drax and Mantis found new purposes
- **Audience Favorite** — 95% audience score makes it one of the most beloved MCU films

## Fun Facts

- James Gunn wrote the script before being briefly fired and rehired by Disney
- The film''s animal cruelty themes were inspired by real animal testing practices
- Dave Bautista confirmed this is his final appearance as Drax
- The Guardians'' final walk together mirrors their first walk in the original film
- Nathan Fillion has a cameo as Master Karja of the Orgoscope

## Viewing Context

Vol. 3 follows **Guardians Vol. 2**, **Avengers: Infinity War/Endgame**, **Thor: Love and Thunder**, and the **Guardians Holiday Special**. This version of Gamora is from the past (brought forward in Endgame) and doesn''t remember the team. The film is a complete trilogy conclusion.',
  metaDescription = 'Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023) — James Gunn finale, $845M box office, 82% RT, and trading card market analysis for Marvel collectors.',
  keywords = 'Guardians Galaxy Vol 3, MCU Phase 5, James Gunn, Rocket Raccoon, Adam Warlock, Star-Lord, trading cards, Marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Guardians Galaxy Vol 3 cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Guardians Vol 3 on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023) is available on Disney+. It is James Gunn''s final MCU film and the conclusion of the Guardians trilogy."},{"question":"Is this the last Guardians movie?","answer":"Yes — Vol. 3 is the final Guardians of the Galaxy film directed by James Gunn. Dave Bautista confirmed it is his last time as Drax. Rocket leads a new team of Guardians at the end."},{"question":"What Vol 3 cards are valuable?","answer":"Bradley Cooper Rocket autos ($3,000+) are rare voice actor cards. Chris Pratt Star-Lord autos ($2,500+) and Dave Bautista final Drax autos ($2,000+) carry farewell premium. Will Poulter Adam Warlock debut autos ($1,500+) have long-term potential."},{"question":"Who is Adam Warlock?","answer":"Adam Warlock (Will Poulter) is a cosmic being created by the Sovereign to destroy the Guardians. He is one of Marvel''s most powerful characters and was teased in Vol. 2''s post-credits scene."},{"question":"What happens to the Guardians at the end?","answer":"The team disbands: Quill returns to Earth to find his grandfather, Rocket leads a new Guardians team, Drax and Nebula stay on Knowhere, Mantis goes on a solo journey, and Gamora rejoins the Ravagers."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3-2023'
